about.title:
Living fully
in God.
about.mission:
Faith that transforms.
Love that reaches out.
about.p1: As servants of God, our mission is to serve and help those most in need, always guided by the Word of God. We strive to prepare a generation of children, young people, and adults who not only know the Gospel but also boldly proclaim it in their schools, workplaces, and homes, bringing light where it is needed most.
about.p2: We firmly believe that giving our lives to Christ and living fully in Him leads us beyond a victorious life to a life that is more than victorious. Because we know that with Christ, all things are possible!
about.p3: Our desire is for the message of salvation and hope in Jesus Christ to reach every corner of the world, beginning in our homes. We trust that His word never returns empty, but transforms lives with His abundant mercy, peace, and love for everyone who believes in their heart.
about.verse: Jesus said to him, ‘If you can believe, all things are possible to the one who believes.’
about.photo: Roca y Potencia identity displayed at the church

welcome.title:
We’re so glad
you’re here.
welcome.heading: God’s invitation
welcome.body: The Bible teaches us that when we return to God with a sincere heart and seek Him, He will let us find Him while there is still time. His love for you is unfailing, and He patiently waits to restore, sustain, and guide you. His doors are always open to everyone who desires to seek Him. Today He invites us to return to Him with a humble heart. God alone restores with love and grace.
welcome.verse: ‘Even now,’ declares the Lord, ‘return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning. Tear your hearts and not your garments.’ Return to the Lord your God, for He is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in mercy, and relents from bringing calamity.
